## Issue

Reference the Issue and apply matching type labels to both it and this PR: `bug`, `fix`, `feat`, `docs`, `chore`, or `release`. Use `Closes #N` only when all acceptance criteria are met. Bootstrap PR #2 is exempt from the Issue requirement.

## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

Record relevant checks, actual results, and limitations; include sanitized screenshots for UI changes. Independent review and green required CI on the current PR head are required before merge.
